name: The Spirit Weaver
source:
The Spirit Weaver is a visual novel game set in the beautiful and mystical realms of the spirits. A strange darkness known as The Entropy is threatening the realm, absorbing the spiritual powers of its denizens and causing many to disappear. You play as a Tarot Reader, summoned by your Spirit Guides to bring aid to the realm. Your mission is to meet and get to know the various confused spirits, help guide them by using the power of Tarot, and ultimately restore balance to the Spirit Realm.

This is a bittersweet story about love, grief, and finding ways to keep moving forward. To progress, you must listen to the characters' stories and empathize with how they think and feel to find the best solutions for their problems. The core gameplay revolves around performing Tarot readings. Much like real Tarot, there are no "wrong" or "right" interpretations of the cards, just better and best ones. The quality of your readings determines the fate of the Spirit Realm and your own story.

Will you save this world and someone precious to you, return to Earth without closure, or become trapped in the Spirit Realm forever?

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3885820/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
《灵魂编织者》是一款视觉小说游戏，背景设定在美丽而神秘的灵魂领域。一种被称为“熵”的奇怪黑暗正在威胁这个领域，吸收其居民的精神力量并导致许多人消失。你扮演一名塔罗牌占卜师，被你的灵魂向导召唤来为王国带来援助。你的任务是结识并认识各种困惑的灵魂，利用塔罗牌的力量帮助引导他们，最终恢复灵界的平衡。

这是一个关于爱、悲伤和寻找继续前进的方法的苦乐参半的故事。为了取得进步，你必须倾听角色的故事并理解他们的想法和感受，以找到解决他们问题的最佳解决方案。核心游戏玩法围绕着塔罗牌占卜。就像真正的塔罗牌一样，纸牌没有“错误”或“正确”的解释，只有更好和最好的解释。你的阅读质量决定了灵界的命运和你自己的故事。

你会拯救这个世界和你所珍视的人，返回地球而不关闭，还是永远被困在灵界？

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3885820/]Steam[/url]]
